# ex: match composite literal with type
ex {
	var x int
	var y int
	T{x, y} -> T{y, x}
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct {
	A int
	B int
}

func F() T {
	return T{1, 2}
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -6,5 +6,5 @@
 }

 func F() T {
-	return T{1, 2}
+	return T{2, 1}
 }
